data.narrative:
Eridu is a Series A semiconductor company that has raised approximately $230M to date. The relevant comp universe spans 11 private and public peers in the Chips & Semiconductors sector, including three public companies (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and eight private firms such as SambaNova Systems, Cerebras, PsiQuantum, Etched, and Tenstorrent.

A peer-median valuation method is not applicable here. The narrow peer set—filtered by stage, adjacency, and valuation tier—yielded insufficient datapoints (fewer than three comparable companies). While the broader Chips & Semiconductors universe contains 11 peers, none of the tighter filtering criteria produced a statistically reliable cohort. Applying an all-sector median would introduce noise and misrepresent Eridu's position within the frontier hardware segment.

Without sufficient narrow comparables or other triangulation methods documented in this dataset, a specific valuation range cannot be derived. The primary uncertainty is the scarcity of directly comparable companies at Eridu's stage and valuation tier within semiconductors. Future valuation work would require either broadening the peer set (accepting some methodological compromise), sourcing additional data on the five named private peers' recent round economics, or deploying alternative methods such as DCF or revenue multiple analysis—none of which are available here. The $230M raised to date anchors a floor, but establishing a defensible post-money valuation requires additional inputs.
